description: Runs a single read-only SELECT over the app’s `sql_api` views (see get_sql_schema for views, columns and limits). The server rejects anything other than SELECT, runs it in a read-only transaction with a timeout and row limit, and logs the query. Results may contain personal data; select only the columns you need. Example: {"query":"select platform, count(*) from sql_api.subscriptions group by 1"}. Required scope: users:read.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

row_limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default from get_sql_schema limits).

name: run_sql_query
title: Run read-only SQL query
